scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Hi. I'm the new member of the Dandelion band Ragi. I am making songs on behalf of Aigu. Are you interested in a story?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I am collecting stories to make a song on behalf of Aigu.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text:
Only adventurers from Eden Group are welcome here.
I'm giving requests to base level ^FF0000130-140^000000 adventurers only.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Haha. I am sorry to request to adventurers even though I am a new.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Just take a look at the list. Can you help me if it is okay with you?
Request to collect stories
Conversation

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: This song and story is about monsters. ^FF0000Tell me the story about how you felt while you were fighting with them.^000000

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I will continue to make a story or songs. But adventurers should step into a new adventure.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: This is the request of Aigu but it is dangerous. You should grow up more.
The story of the lost
Story of devil
Story from far away distance

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Lighthalzen has many stories that I'm sure are sad and lost. Their stories should not be forgotten so please tell me what you can.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Do you know the story about Satan Morocc? I want to sing a song of their story even when time passes by.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I never been to Ash Vacuum but I heard there are many interesting creatures there in the Scaraba Hall.
Egnigem Cenia (Swordman Monster)
Armeyer Dinze (Merchant Monster)
Wickebine Tres (Thief Monster)
Kavach Icarus (Archer Monster)
Errende Ebecee (Acolyte Monster)
Laurell Weinder (Mage Monster)

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: She is a sad swordman in such a far away place. What brought here there do you think?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Have you heard any new stories? Please tell me stories if you have any from your journey.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: A sword woman who is stronger than any swordmen. Egnigem Cenia. That is her name. I am not sure if that is her or someone else.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: How far could she have continued her journey? I guess she could not do it alone.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: A daughter of a merchant. Armeyer Dinze, she looks like a rich woman. But she looks insecure.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: What might have moved her mind? She only cared about money.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Nobody knows how it has started. Wickebine Tres is the name who could have found a true companion.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Yes. It seems that I have heard the same name from Payon. I am not sure it means the same.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Kavach Icarus is the name whose hands are faster than eyes and shoots arrows swiftly.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: No matter if it was for friendship or a mission. If that journey was for someone, It would not be easy to stop the journey.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Errende Ebecee is the one who started a journey to look for someone.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: By the way. I have read a book called ^FF0000How to be a wizard^000000...

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Laurell Weinder, who decided to have a difficult journey to repay gratitude for some wizards deed.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Some adventurers tell me stories a little bit but they are not enough to make a song out of.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: These are very important stories to someone. I want to make a song with these stories. Please help me.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I can not lose her story. I really wish you to stop by.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: It will be more dangerous than you think. But story must be conveyed for everyone.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: You do not wonder why that journey should have stopped?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I want to make a song with these stories. Please help me.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: What made her disappear? Or for what? Please listen to her story.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: It will be more dangerous than you think. But the story must be conveyed.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I wonder how far her heart has been reached? Please listen to her story. Please tell me.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please make a song for us.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: She was the one who only cared for money. How far has her journey continued? Please listen to her story in Lighthalzen.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: It will be more dangerous than you think. But the story must be conveyed.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please try to find him or a bow at Lighthalzen.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please do not forget to tell me any story you hear.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I heard his shadow and his arrow are wandering somewhere. Please go to Lighthalzen and tell me his story.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please be careful of his arrows. You may have laid down on the cold floor before this story is finished.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: What made stopped their journey? What kind of story is in it?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please check that story in Lighthalzen.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But I guess... His journey also might have stopped somewhere in Lighthalzen. Please listen to his story.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please be careful not get lost like these ^FF0000poor souls^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: According to that book, some magic by 25 years olds can be stronger than older wizards.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: What are you listening to seriously? Let's finish the request about Laurell Weinders story!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But... These talented wizards could not return? Who made them? Find a clue in Lighthalzen.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I like this story but be careful if you do not want to end up a story yourself.
Angel Incarnation
Black Nightmare Incarnation
Ghost Incarnation

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: A monster from Morocc has wings like an angel. Maybe, Satan Morocc wants to be an angel?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Appearance looks fine but inside.. I am sure they are flesh and blood!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Wow. There are so many stories coming to me! Thanks to you!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Well... This song is not about the prince of darkness, but it is taken from people who claim to have seen him.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: The shape is not completed but it has a very sharp tooth.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I do not know if everything came out from Satan Morocc himself but things like this look horrible.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: This story should be spread out for weak adventurers like me! Because not everyone can be adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: This one is weird.. But he is also is an Incarnation of Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Story is not made yet, so I will ask next time !

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: The creature without clothing has very weird shape. Haha do not take it seriously. I am just a story teller.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Haha please do not mind. It is just joke of a story teller. Please give me another story next time.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Of course, I did not check by myself. But I am just a story teller as you see.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But it is not safe.. So be careful! Please give me more stories! Maybe I can meet Satan Morocc somewhere around here?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Please help me to make a story by searching the flying Incarnations of Morocc.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.text: Be sure to get at least 30 Angel looking Incarnations of Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Do not you think that is going to be a very funny story?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But I think there also will be a story in it. That is why those creature are made. Please look for something black and tar-like.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Find and get rid of 30 Dark Incarnation of Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Maybe, adventurers have a good merit to know this kind of story. So can you please look for these creatures near Morocc?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But I am curious because it looks like a ghost and attacks does not work.
Take the request
Quit.

scripts.text: They also have some stories right? First, I wonder about the shape of the one with one horn.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I wonder what Uni-Horn Scarabas think? I want to make a song. Thanks for your help!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: New world is full of amazing monsters. They will become a dream for children who want to be adventurers.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: That horn thing bothers me a little bit. What is the difference between one and two horns? Just appearance?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: You came back safely! How is it? Horn Scaraba seemed to be a fun story. You really did a good job.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: We talk about Horn Scaraba? There is one more we should mention.. That is Horn Scaraba!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: There seemed to be more special Scarabas according to rumors. Stronger and more scary ones.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: It must be tiring traveling long distance! Please tell me if there are more interesting stories!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: This one is very unique! Horns look like the one of a deer so it is called an Antler Scaraba.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Here my plan is. I am making 4 passages for each Scaraba.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Thank you ! I am sure that I can make a great song.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I'm starting to get confused. I am going to make a song of the Rake Horn Scarabas story.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I am making a story about Uni-Horn Scaraba. One means less than two!~ I started but it is difficult to finish. Can you help me?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I am making a story... Two means less than three~ I started to make a story but I can not finish. Will you help me?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: There seem to be more story about Antler Scaraba! Please help me if you have time.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I feel like Rake Horn Scaraba has more story. Please help me if you have time.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I want to make a song about the ^FF0000Uni-Horn Scaraba^000000!? Children will really like it.

Quit.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Maybe it is unnecessary. But curiosity is important for story tellers. Hahaha.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I do no know why. I just heard from people. I need to make a song so please take a look at their world!
Take the request

scripts.text: Please find a story about Rake Horn Scaraba from Scaraba Hall. Battle or experienced stories are fine.

scripts.text: I hope to see you again as we farewell with smile.

Where did you get your hair-do?
Please sing a song for me.

About Aigu

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: There is a fine hair artist in Alberta. He butchered my hair with a some cooking scissors. Looks illegal.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I will never forget the first day I met her. She stared at me out of all the people in Izlude port. Now I help her by doing small errands.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I did not make a song as a member of band yet. Someday, I will make a great song for you!

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Sometimes, hair-dos or color are strange... but I was lucky I didn't die.

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: Aigu is only on my mind. I can not think of anything else. I am fine even if it is just a one-sided love...

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But alas, I think Aigu likes someone else. ^FF0000We've never met... But I hate him.^000000

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: But I hate myself more because I want to stay around her even if she will never see me. Haha was I too serious?

scripts.speaker: Ragi
scripts.text: I am just a storyteller.. Any story can be made up. Most of the times it contains the truth.
